mapper.sql: ubu.usage_id AS benefit_history_id, approval.merchant_name, COALESCE(ubu.approved_at, approval.approved_at) AS approved_at, approval.amount AS payment_amount, ubu.reward_amount_krw AS benefit_amount, CASE WHEN ubu.reward_original_unit = 'mile' THEN 'MILEAGE' WHEN ubu.reward_original_unit = 'point' THEN 'POINT' WHEN bo.reward_type = 'discount' THEN 'DISCOUNT' WHEN bo.reward_type = 'cashback' THEN 'CASHBACK' WHEN bo.reward_type = 'points' THEN 'POINT' END AS benefit_type, COALESCE(bo.offer_name, cb.title) AS benefit_title, ubu.user_card_id, CONCAT_WS(' ', COALESCE(cv.name, uc.card_name_from_codef), NULLIF(TRIM(uc.card_no), '')) AS card_name, 'APPLIED' AS calculation_status

FROM user_benefit_usages ubu INNER JOIN user_cards uc ON uc.user_card_id = ubu.user_card_id INNER JOIN card_payment_approvals approval ON approval.approval_id = ubu.approval_id INNER JOIN benefit_offers bo ON bo.offer_id = ubu.offer_id INNER JOIN card_benefits cb ON cb.benefit_id = bo.benefit_id LEFT JOIN cards c ON c.card_id = uc.card_id LEFT JOIN card_content_versions cv ON cv.card_id = c.card_id AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM card_content_versions newer WHERE newer.card_id = cv.card_id AND (newer.last_seen_at > cv.last_seen_at OR (newer.last_seen_at = cv.last_seen_at AND newer.content_version_id > cv.content_version_id))) WHERE uc.user_id = #{userId} AND ubu.usage_status = 'confirmed' AND COALESCE(ubu.approved_at, approval.approved_at) >= #{fromUtc} AND COALESCE(ubu.approved_at, approval.approved_at) < #{toUtc} AND bo.reward_type IN ('discount', 'cashback', 'points') AND ubu.user_card_id = #{userCardId} AND CASE WHEN ubu.reward_original_unit = 'mile' THEN 'MILEAGE' WHEN ubu.reward_original_unit = 'point' THEN 'POINT' WHEN bo.reward_type = 'discount' THEN 'DISCOUNT' WHEN bo.reward_type = 'cashback' THEN 'CASHBACK' WHEN bo.reward_type = 'points' THEN 'POINT' END = #{benefitType}
mapper.select: SELECT CAST(COALESCE(SUM(ubu.reward_amount_krw), 0) AS SIGNED) AS total_benefit_amount, CAST(COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN (ubu.reward_original_unit IS NULL OR ubu.reward_original_unit NOT IN ('point', 'mile')) AND bo.reward_type = 'discount' THEN ubu.reward_amount_krw ELSE 0 END), 0) AS SIGNED) AS discount_amount, CAST(COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN (ubu.reward_original_unit IS NULL OR ubu.reward_original_unit NOT IN ('point', 'mile')) AND bo.reward_type = 'cashback' THEN ubu.reward_amount_krw ELSE 0 END), 0) AS SIGNED) AS cashback_amount, CAST(COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN ubu.reward_original_unit = 'point' THEN ubu.reward_original_value WHEN ubu.reward_original_unit IS NULL AND bo.reward_type = 'points' THEN ubu.reward_amount_krw ELSE 0 END), 0) AS SIGNED) AS point_amount, CAST(COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN ubu.reward_original_unit = 'mile' THEN ubu.reward_original_value ELSE 0 END), 0) AS SIGNED) AS mileage_amount FROM user_benefit_usages ubu INNER JOIN user_cards uc ON uc.user_card_id = ubu.user_card_id INNER JOIN card_payment_approvals approval ON approval.approval_id = ubu.approval_id INNER JOIN benefit_offers bo ON bo.offer_id = ubu.offer_id WHERE uc.user_id = #{userId} AND ubu.usage_status = 'confirmed' AND COALESCE(ubu.approved_at, approval.approved_at) >= #{fromUtc} AND COALESCE(ubu.approved_at, approval.approved_at) < #{toUtc} AND bo.reward_type IN ('discount', 'cashback', 'points') AND ubu.user_card_id = #{userCardId}

SELECT , CASE WHEN ubu.limit_policy_id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE COALESCE((SELECT SUM(u2.reward_amount_krw) FROM user_benefit_usages u2 WHERE u2.user_card_id = ubu.user_card_id AND u2.limit_policy_id = ubu.limit_policy_id AND u2.usage_status = 'confirmed' AND DATE_FORMAT(u2.usage_date, '%Y-%m') = DATE_FORMAT(ubu.usage_date, '%Y-%m')), 0) END AS monthly_used_amount, COALESCE((SELECT MAX(t.limit_value) FROM benefit_limit_tiers t WHERE t.limit_policy_id = ubu.limit_policy_id), 0) AS monthly_limit_amount, CASE WHEN ubu.reward_original_unit = 'mile' THEN CAST(ubu.reward_original_value AS SIGNED) ELSE NULL END AS earned_mileage FROM user_benefit_usages ubu INNER JOIN user_cards uc ON uc.user_card_id = ubu.user_card_id INNER JOIN card_payment_approvals approval ON approval.approval_id = ubu.approval_id INNER JOIN benefit_offers bo ON bo.offer_id = ubu.offer_id INNER JOIN card_benefits cb ON cb.benefit_id = bo.benefit_id LEFT JOIN cards c ON c.card_id = uc.card_id LEFT JOIN card_content_versions cv ON cv.card_id = c.card_id AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM card_content_versions newer WHERE newer.card_id = cv.card_id AND (newer.last_seen_at > cv.last_seen_at OR (newer.last_seen_at = cv.last_seen_at AND newer.content_version_id > cv.content_version_id))) WHERE uc.user_id = #{userId} AND ubu.usage_status = 'confirmed' AND bo.reward_type IN ('discount', 'cashback', 'points') AND ubu.usage_id = #{usageId}
